_doc: Known EA script errors that fire without our code (ScriptError_*.xml / ErrorTrap). Matched by exception type + the top stack frames in order (suffix of 'Namespace.Type:Method'); a stack with any frame outside EA game script (Sims3.Gameplay*, Sims3.SimIFace, Sims3.UI, ScriptCore, System) never matches, except an entry's own passFrames (verified pass-through hooks of ours, dropped before matching); optional message = regex on the exception message. Matched errors are reported as 'known EA error <id> (ignored)' and counted, never dropped. Loader + matcher: tools/harness/known-script-errors.ts.

errors.why: EA WeddingCeremony.CleanUp dereferences null when the route to the wedding arch fails (InteractionQueue DeQueue -> CleanupInteraction -> OnRouteFailed -> Situation.Exit), lot Sparkling Sands in the Baseline-IP save; fires at random after load, with and without our fixes [verified: 27 probe-out runs from 2026-10-12, before the v0.1.6 hotfix; all frames EA]
evidence: hotfix gate job ip-hf-matrix reload case, 2026-10-25

errors.message: left an object in the Sim's hand with no carry state machine: Sims3\.Gameplay\.Objects\.BookGeneral$
errors.why: EA InteractionQueue.PutDownCarriedObjects throws when an interaction (Bookshelf_ReadSomething, ReadBook, Book_PutAway, ServingContainer+PutAwayLeftovers) ends with a BookGeneral in the Sim's hand and no carry state machine (docs/251). Mostly household Angelista on Baseline-BP, also before ts3fixes existed [verified: this matcher matches 33 ScriptError events in probe-out events.jsonl 2026-10-11..2026-11-12, the first before ts3fixes had a book hook; the handoff counted 57 hits incl. the related CarrySystem.PutDownOnSurface NRE, which this entry does not cover]. ts3fixes BookHandQueueHook (bookhand off) only counts and calls the original, renamed PdcoOrig [verified code, BookHand.cs], so that frame is a listed pass-through. Household scope is not matched: the ErrorTrap Object block can name another Sim. Plate (Sink+WashDishes) is not covered.
evidence: freeze-stress-1112-04 job: household Lala Angelista, Bookshelf_ReadSomething, 2026-11-12
